observations: Durable lesson (could not be recorded to mulch — no .mulch/ dir): hermetic tracker fixtures — tests comparing our reader to sd output must not read the live .seeds/ dir; co-capture issues.jsonl + config.yaml + 'sd list --all --format json' as one fixture pair, materialize into a temp dir, and keep a VOLATILE_FIELDS stable-projection skip so one-half regeneration stays safe (seeds-e218).

Fixture regeneration required `sd list` WITHOUT the --assignee fabro filter (--all): the fixture must mirror every record in issues.jsonl, so the PROJECT_FACTS 'never list without --assignee' rule (a candidate-sourcing rule) does not apply to fixture capture — worth knowing for future regens.

The brief said the live tracker held 7 records; at capture time it held 5 (closed seeds pruned or count stale) — record-count drift between brief-writing and implementation is itself evidence of the hermeticity race this seed fixes.
